exact_statement: For any finite uniform physical controller partition (C_0,C_1,C_2) and independent Boolean cores u_j on disjoint private blocks having a common mean m, put q_j=E C_j, V=1-m^2, h_j=1-2C_j, F=u_kappa and phi(s)=-s log2(s), phi(0)=0. With L(q)=phi(q^2)-phi((1-2q)^2)/4+2q(1-q), H(F)=sum_j q_j H(u_j)+(V/4)sum_j H(h_j)+V sum_j L(q_j). For every actual controller coordinate i, R=V sum_j phi(q_j), E_i=D_i(F)-(V/4)sum_j D_i(h_j)-(R-E R_child) obeys E_i<=14 Inf_i(F), uniformly in all controller/core dimensions and m in [-1,1]. If r_j are supplied C-priced own-history controller potentials under ONE common controller policy, the original P=(V/4)sum_j r_j plus R is a (C+14)-priced controller potential retaining both actual child continuations. More exactly D_i(F)-C Inf_i(F)-(P+R)+E(P_child+R_child)=E_i-s_i, with s_i the actual nonnegative unused cut-transaction slack. At the surjective table (0,0,0,0,1,1,1,2), three independent two-bit point-defect cores of mean 1/2, query 2 and subsequent order 0,1 at C=1, s_i=3/16 while E_i-s_i=(27/64)log2(3)-9/16 lies strictly between 1/10 and 7/64. A separate exact ten-bit mixed-tree certificate with both actual initial data children verifies original P+R+sum q_j Q_1(u_j) at price15 on all1023 internal nodes and zero terminal reserves. No arbitrary unequal-mean continuation, shared-core extension, initial cut-reserve admission, universal FEI bound or Lean certificate is asserted. This adds an equal-mean correction and exact non-flat transaction to the existing A030 three-state cut-reserve candidate; the previous version remains preserved at its original scope.
